info.name: ALU Legal Companion API
info.description:
Every route of the API, run in an order that builds on itself. Each request states what it expects and checks it.

How to run it:
1. Start the server (see the README) and seed it. Import this collection and the environment next to it.
2. Select the environment and run the collection with the Runner, or use Newman: `npx newman run ALU_Legal_Companion.postman_collection.json -e ALU_Legal_Companion.local.postman_environment.json`.

One run uses about half of the 100 sign-in requests that one address may make in 15 minutes. If you run it twice in a row, restart the server or wait 15 minutes between runs, otherwise the server answers 429.
It can be run again and again. Every record it creates has a name with a fresh run id.
It leaves the seeded passwords as they were. It does create a few published directory entries, routes, guides and checklists with the name “Postman”. Run it on a development or demo database only.
Email links and invitation codes are only in the server’s log or an inbox, so the collection checks the refusals for those routes and not the success path.
The same routes are described in Swagger at /api/docs on the server. Uploads need DOCUMENT_KEY on the server. Without it the upload requests expect 503 and the checks that need a file say they are skipped.
